title: Give Plants
text:
/cultivation giveplant id <player> <id> [host] [count]


/cultivation giveplant filter <player> <element> [tier] [host] [count]


Tab suggests plant IDs with names, elements and tiers. Host defaults to false; true adds source data to eligible T3 plants.


Count: 1-64, default 1. Optional arguments must be supplied in order.
